title: CLAT Practice Set 2
pageDesc: Free CLAT practice paper set 2 with detailed solutions.

questions.text: The basic structure doctrine was established in:

options.label: A
options.text: Maneka Gandhi (1978)

options.label: B
options.text: Kesavananda Bharati (1973)

options.label: C
options.text: Minerva Mills (1980)

options.label: D
options.text: S.R. Bommai (1994)

questions.text: According to the passage, which of the following best describes an implicit assumption in an argument?

options.label: A
options.text: A stated reason supporting the claim.

options.label: B
options.text: An unstated belief necessary for the argument to hold.

options.label: C
options.text: A counterargument presented for refutation.

options.label: D
options.text: A statistical evidence cited by the author.

questions.solution: Correct answer: An unstated belief necessary for the argument to hold..

questions.text: A candidate encounters an inference question where one option is factually true in the real world but not supported by the passage. According to the Principle of Passage‑Only Reasoning, how should this option be treated?

options.label: A
options.text: Select it because it is factually correct

options.label: B
options.text: Eliminate it because answers must be grounded exclusively in the passage

options.label: C
options.text: Select it if it aligns with the candidate's domain knowledge

options.label: D
options.text: Mark it as correct only if the passage does not contradict it

questions.solution: Correct answer: Eliminate it because answers must be grounded exclusively in the passage.

questions.text: Paragraph 1 cites a single study showing a 12% rise in test scores after a policy change. Paragraph 3 reveals the study had a small sample and short duration. The author concludes the policy is universally effective. This conclusion is:

options.label: A
options.text: Supported by the evidence presented.

options.label: B
options.text: Weakened by the omitted limitations noted later.

options.label: C
options.text: Irrelevant to the study’s findings.

options.label: D
options.text: Strengthened by the later paragraph’s details.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Weakened by the omitted limitations noted later..

questions.text: For a question stem “All of the following are supported by the passage EXCEPT,” the most efficient method described in the passage is:

options.label: A
options.text: Choose the option that is false in the real world.

options.label: B
options.text: Locate evidence for each option in the passage; the one lacking support is the answer.

options.label: C
options.text: Select the option that contains the strongest hedging language.

options.label: D
options.text: Pick the longest option.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Locate evidence for each option in the passage; the one lacking support is the answer..

questions.text: Which statement accurately reflects the outcome of the 15th General Quota Review of the IMF completed in 2020?

options.label: A
options.text: Quotas were increased and the formula was revised to give more weight to purchasing‑power‑parity GDP.

options.label: B
options.text: Quotas were left unchanged because members could not agree on a new formula that would further increase the share of fast‑growing economies.

options.label: C
options.text: Quotas were doubled again and the United States veto threshold was lowered from 15% to 10%.

options.label: D
options.text: Quotas were reduced for advanced economies and increased for emerging market economies.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Quotas were left unchanged because members could not agree on a new formula that would further increase the share of fast‑growing economies..

questions.text: Which of the following correctly matches the South African capital city with its governmental function?

options.label: A
options.text: Pretoria – Legislative; Cape Town – Executive; Bloemfontein – Judicial

options.label: B
options.text: Pretoria – Executive; Cape Town – Legislative; Bloemfontein – Judicial

options.label: C
options.text: Pretoria – Judicial; Cape Town – Executive; Bloemfontein – Legislative

options.label: D
options.text: Pretoria – Executive; Cape Town – Judicial; Bloemfontein – Legislative

questions.solution: Correct answer: Pretoria – Executive; Cape Town – Legislative; Bloemfontein – Judicial.

questions.text: Which of the following best defines the 'Almost Right' trap as described in the passage's section on Diagnostic Answer-Option Forensics?

options.label: A
options.text: An option that uses high-frequency passage vocabulary to exploit familiarity heuristic

options.label: B
options.text: An option that contains a verifiably true statement from the passage but fails the question's specific demand

options.label: C
options.text: An option that applies a statutory interpretation canon outside its proper jurisdictional domain

options.label: D
options.text: An option that infers causation from a historical correlation without corroborating evidence

questions.solution: Correct answer: An option that contains a verifiably true statement from the passage but fails the question's specific demand.

questions.text: A State legislature enacts a law on "public health" (a State List entry) which incidentally affects "trade and commerce" (a Union List entry). The court upholds the law, finding that its dominant purpose lies within the State's competence. Which test did the court apply?

options.label: A
options.text: Doctrine of Eclipse

options.label: B
options.text: Doctrine of Severability

options.label: C
options.text: Pith and Substance test

options.label: D
options.text: Basic Structure doctrine

questions.solution: Correct answer: Pith and Substance test.

questions.text: Which factor is a stronger indicator of a capital city's diplomatic hub status than the number of embassies?

options.label: A
options.text: Number of consulates.

options.label: B
options.text: Presence of permanent secretariats and recurring summit cycles.

options.label: C
options.text: Size of the foreign ministry.

options.label: D
options.text: Volume of tourist arrivals.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Presence of permanent secretariats and recurring summit cycles..

questions.text: Which group of countries was added to BRICS during its 2024 expansion?

options.label: A
options.text: Argentina, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia

options.label: B
options.text: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE, Saudi Arabia

options.label: C
options.text: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Indonesia, UAE

options.label: D
options.text: Algeria, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE

questions.solution: Correct answer: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, UAE, Saudi Arabia.

questions.text: The passage lists several common traps in advanced reading comprehension. Which of the following is explicitly identified as a trap?

options.label: A
options.text: Confusing the author's tone with the tone of a cited expert.

options.label: B
options.text: Over-inferring from limited evidence.

options.label: C
options.text: Failing to identify the main idea of each paragraph.

options.label: D
options.text: Misreading complex vocabulary.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Over-inferring from limited evidence..

questions.text: Which treaty body monitors the implementation of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR)?

options.label: A
options.text: Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (CESCR)

options.label: B
options.text: Human Rights Committee (CCPR)

options.label: C
options.text: Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination (CERD)

options.label: D
options.text: Committee against Torture (CAT)

questions.text: How is a member's voting power calculated in the IMF according to the Key Mechanisms described?

options.label: A
options.text: Solely based on quota size with one vote per SDR 100,000 of quota.

options.label: B
options.text: Basic votes distributed equally (5.502% of total votes) plus one additional vote per SDR 100,000 of quota.

options.label: C
options.text: Based on the GDP weight (50%) and openness (30%) components of the quota formula.

options.label: D
options.text: Determined by the double‑majority rule requiring a 70% majority of total voting power and a majority of member countries.

questions.solution: Correct answer: Basic votes distributed equally (5.502% of total votes) plus one additional vote per SDR 100,000 of quota..

questions.text: Under the doctrine of eclipse, a pre‑constitutional statute inconsistent with a fundamental right becomes:

options.label: A
options.text: Repealed and cannot be revived without fresh legislation

options.label: B
options.text: Void ab initio and permanently unenforceable

options.label: C
options.text: Dormant and capable of revival if the constitutional impediment is removed by amendment

options.label: D
options.text: Valid but subject to judicial modification to conform to the fundamental right

questions.solution: Correct answer: Dormant and capable of revival if the constitutional impediment is removed by amendment.
